concept.title: What a service helps with joins up unrelated services
concept.shortdesc: Recording the need a service meets lets very different kinds of service be found together.

conbody.p: A strength-and-balance class at a leisure centre and an NHS falls-prevention service are different kinds of thing. Both help someone stay steady on their feet.
A social prescriber searches by the need, and should find both. Recording “what it helps with” as its own dimension makes that possible.
